changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = N'Setting') AND NOT EXISTS (Select * from [dbo].[Setting] where id =61) BEGIN INSERT INTO [dbo].[Setting] ( ID, FieldName, Name, Description, DefaultValue ) Values ( 61, 'WriteActionDescription', 'Write Action Description', 'Write Action Description to Comments', 'true' ) END
